title: 區域冷卻管網~District-cooling pipe networks
focus: 冷量傳輸、壓降與低溫差診斷~Cooling transfer, pressure loss and low-temperature-difference diagnosis
summary: 以「冷量傳輸、壓降與低溫差診斷」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow cooling transfer, pressure loss and low-temperature-difference diagnosis through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 冷量與水流~Cooling duty and flow
units.mechanism: 冷量由質量流率、比熱與供回水溫差決定；流量不能獨立代表服務量。~Cooling duty is mass flow times heat capacity and temperature difference; flow alone does not measure service.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K；計算 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW。適用限制：水的定比熱近似。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K; calculation 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW. Applicability: Constant water heat-capacity approximation.
units.verify: 改變溫差並保持流量，觀察冷量。~Vary temperature difference at fixed flow and observe duty.
units.failure: 高流量低溫差可能仍傳送不足冷量。~High flow with low temperature difference can still deliver insufficient cooling.
units.misconception: 供水流量越大就一定提供越多有效冷量。~Higher flow always delivers more useful cooling.
units.practice: 在「冷量與水流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 501.6 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「高流量低溫差可能仍傳送不足冷量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for cooling duty and flow, first reproduce 501.6 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "High flow with low temperature difference can still deliver insufficient cooling." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 管徑與流速~Pipe diameter and velocity
units.mechanism: 流速影響壓降、噪音和控制；管徑以截面平方影響速度。~Velocity affects pressure drop, noise and control; diameter changes area quadratically.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：v=4Q/(pi D^2);Q=0.02 m3/s;D=0.15m；計算 4*0.02/(pi*0.15**2) = 1.13177 m/s。適用限制：單圓管滿流。~Original hypothetical teaching example: v=4Q/(pi D^2);Q=0.02 m3/s;D=0.15m; calculation 4*0.02/(pi*0.15**2) = 1.13177 m/s. Applicability: Full flow in one circular pipe.
units.verify: 管徑減少10%，比較流速增加幅度。~Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase.
units.failure: 內徑與公稱管徑混用會偏移壓降估算。~Mixing internal and nominal diameters biases pressure loss.
units.misconception: 管徑減半只會讓流速加倍。~Halving diameter merely doubles velocity.
units.practice: 在「管徑與流速」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.13177 m/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「內徑與公稱管徑混用會偏移壓降估算。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pipe diameter and velocity, first reproduce 1.13177 m/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing internal and nominal diameters biases pressure loss." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 沿程壓降~Distributed pressure loss
units.mechanism: 達西摩擦因數須與雷諾數和粗糙度相容；局部元件損失另列。~Match Darcy friction factor to Reynolds number and roughness; list local losses separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：DeltaP=f(L/D)rho v^2/2;f=0.02;L=200;D=0.15;rho=1000;v=1.2；計算 0.02*(200/0.15)*1000*1.2**2/2 = 19200 Pa。適用限制：假想固定摩擦因數。~Original hypothetical teaching example: DeltaP=f(L/D)rho v^2/2;f=0.02;L=200;D=0.15;rho=1000;v=1.2; calculation 0.02*(200/0.15)*1000*1.2**2/2 = 19200 Pa. Applicability: Hypothetical fixed Darcy factor.
units.verify: 將流速增加20%，重算平方效應。~Increase velocity20% and recalculate the square-law effect.
units.failure: 漏算換熱器和閥損會低估泵揚程。~Omitting exchanger and valve losses understates pump head.
units.misconception: 管路壓降與流速永遠成一次正比。~Pipe pressure drop is always linearly proportional to speed.
units.practice: 在「沿程壓降」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 19200 Pa，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「漏算換熱器和閥損會低估泵揚程。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for distributed pressure loss, first reproduce 19200 Pa, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Omitting exchanger and valve losses understates pump head." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 泵浦與電力~Pumping and electricity
units.mechanism: 電功率是液壓功除效率；變頻節能需看系統曲線與最低壓差。~Electrical power is hydraulic power divided by efficiency; variable-speed savings depend on system curves and minimum differential pressure.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：P=DeltaP Q/eta;DeltaP=60000;Q=0.02;eta=0.75；計算 60000*0.02/0.75/1000 = 1.6 kW。適用限制：不含馬達外其他輔機。~Original hypothetical teaching example: P=DeltaP Q/eta;DeltaP=60000;Q=0.02;eta=0.75; calculation 60000*0.02/0.75/1000 = 1.6 kW. Applicability: Excludes other auxiliaries.
units.verify: 同步記錄流量、壓差與耗電檢查效率。~Record flow, pressure and electricity to check efficiency.
units.failure: 用名牌最高效率代表所有負載會高估節能。~Using nameplate peak efficiency at every load overstates savings.
units.misconception: 泵浦效率在所有轉速都固定不變。~Pump efficiency is constant at all speeds.
units.practice: 在「泵浦與電力」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.6 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用名牌最高效率代表所有負載會高估節能。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pumping and electricity, first reproduce 1.6 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using nameplate peak efficiency at every load overstates savings." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 低溫差症候群~Low-delta-T syndrome
units.mechanism: 回水溫差過小迫使相同冷量使用更多水，增加網路流量與泵功。~A small return temperature difference requires more water for equal duty, increasing network flow and pumping.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：m=Q/(cp DeltaT);Q=500;cp=4.18;DeltaT=3；計算 500/(4.18*3) = 39.8724 kg/s。適用限制：固定冷量與定比熱。~Original hypothetical teaching example: m=Q/(cp DeltaT);Q=500;cp=4.18;DeltaT=3; calculation 500/(4.18*3) = 39.8724 kg/s. Applicability: Fixed duty and heat capacity.
units.verify: 比較DeltaT為3K與6K的流量需求。~Compare required flow at3K and6K.
units.failure: 閥常開或換熱器控制不良可能造成旁通混水。~Stuck-open valves or poor exchanger control can cause bypass mixing.
units.misconception: 回水越接近供水溫度就代表系統越有效率。~A return temperature closer to supply means higher efficiency.
units.practice: 在「低溫差症候群」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 39.8724 kg/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「閥常開或換熱器控制不良可能造成旁通混水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for low-delta-t syndrome, first reproduce 39.8724 kg/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Stuck-open valves or poor exchanger control can cause bypass mixing." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 換熱器溫差推動~Heat-exchanger driving difference
units.mechanism: 換熱器傳熱以面積、總傳熱係數和對數平均溫差連結；污垢降低有效UA。~Heat transfer links area, overall coefficient and logarithmic mean difference; fouling lowers effective UA.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：LMTD=(DeltaT1-DeltaT2)/ln(DeltaT1/DeltaT2);8,4；計算 (8-4)/log(8/4) = 5.77078 K。適用限制：逆流理想化且無相變。~Original hypothetical teaching example: LMTD=(DeltaT1-DeltaT2)/ln(DeltaT1/DeltaT2);8,4; calculation (8-4)/log(8/4) = 5.77078 K. Applicability: Ideal counterflow without phase change.
units.verify: 比較清潔與污損時所需面積或流量。~Compare clean/fouled area or flow requirements.
units.failure: 只增加流量可能無法補救受限UA。~More flow may not compensate for limited UA.
units.misconception: 換熱器溫差可直接用任意兩端算術平均代替。~Any arithmetic average of endpoint differences replaces LMTD.
units.practice: 在「換熱器溫差推動」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 5.77078 K，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只增加流量可能無法補救受限UA。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for heat-exchanger driving difference, first reproduce 5.77078 K, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "More flow may not compensate for limited UA." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 管線熱增益~Heat gain in pipes
units.mechanism: 保溫和埋地環境決定沿線冷量損失；供回兩管需個別記錄。~Insulation and surroundings govern heat gain; account for supply and return separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：heat gain=Uprime L DeltaT;Uprime=0.4 W/m/K;L=500;DeltaT=20；計算 0.4*500*20/1000 = 4 kW。適用限制：線性穩態熱傳估算。~Original hypothetical teaching example: heat gain=Uprime L DeltaT;Uprime=0.4 W/m/K;L=500;DeltaT=20; calculation 0.4*500*20/1000 = 4 kW. Applicability: Linear steady heat-transfer estimate.
units.verify: 比較保溫受潮前後的Uprime。~Compare line conductance before and after insulation wetting.
units.failure: 保溫受潮可能同時增加熱損與腐蝕風險。~Wet insulation can increase both thermal loss and corrosion concerns.
units.misconception: 地下管線完全不會與環境交換熱。~Buried pipes exchange no heat with the environment.
units.practice: 在「管線熱增益」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 4 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「保溫受潮可能同時增加熱損與腐蝕風險。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for heat gain in pipes, first reproduce 4 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Wet insulation can increase both thermal loss and corrosion concerns." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 蓄冷容量與削峰~Thermal-storage capacity and peak shaving
units.mechanism: 水蓄冷以有效溫差儲能；混合破壞分層會降低可用容量。~Water storage holds energy through useful temperature difference; mixing destroys stratification and reduces usable capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：E=rho V cp DeltaT/3600;rho=1000;V=100;cp=4.18;DeltaT=6；計算 1000*100*4.18*6/3600 = 696.667 kWh。適用限制：理想水槽顯熱，未扣混合與損失。~Original hypothetical teaching example: E=rho V cp DeltaT/3600;rho=1000;V=100;cp=4.18;DeltaT=6; calculation 1000*100*4.18*6/3600 = 696.667 kWh. Applicability: Ideal sensible storage before mixing and losses.
units.verify: 提高無效混合比例並比較可用削峰時數。~Increase mixing loss and compare usable peak-shaving hours.
units.failure: 總水量乘最大溫差會高估已混合水槽容量。~Total volume times maximum deltaT overstates a mixed tank.
units.misconception: 任何混合狀態下儲槽容量都一樣。~Storage capacity is independent of mixing state.
units.practice: 在「蓄冷容量與削峰」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 696.667 kWh，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「總水量乘最大溫差會高估已混合水槽容量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for thermal-storage capacity and peak shaving, first reproduce 696.667 kWh, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total volume times maximum deltaT overstates a mixed tank." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 多用戶同時率~Demand coincidence
units.mechanism: 個別最大冷量不一定同時出現；以同步時序估計網路峰值。~Individual maxima need not coincide; use synchronized series for network peak.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：coincidence=network peak/sum individual peaks;800/1000；計算 800/1000 = 0.8 fraction。適用限制：假想同期間量測。~Original hypothetical teaching example: coincidence=network peak/sum individual peaks;800/1000; calculation 800/1000 = 0.8 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical measurements over the same period.
units.verify: 比較相加最大值與逐時加總後最大值。~Compare summed individual maxima with the maximum hourly sum.
units.failure: 用月帳單平均值估尖峰可能低估設備需求。~Monthly-average billing data can understate peak requirements.
units.misconception: 所有用戶最大負載一定同時發生。~All customer maxima occur simultaneously.
units.practice: 在「多用戶同時率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.8 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用月帳單平均值估尖峰可能低估設備需求。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for demand coincidence, first reproduce 0.8 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Monthly-average billing data can understate peak requirements." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 熱量計誤差與交接~Heat-meter uncertainty and handover
units.mechanism: 流量與供回溫差共同決定計費冷量；小溫差時溫度偏差尤其重要。~Flow and temperature difference jointly determine metered cooling; temperature bias matters especially at low deltaT.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：relative DeltaT error=0.2/3；計算 0.2/3 = 0.0666667 fraction。適用限制：固定差溫偏差的示例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: relative DeltaT error=0.2/3; calculation 0.2/3 = 0.0666667 fraction. Applicability: Example of fixed differential-temperature bias.
units.verify: 交換兩支溫度探頭位置，檢查偏差方向。~Swap temperature probes and check bias direction.
units.failure: 未配對校正探頭會把量測偏差當網路損失。~Unmatched probe calibration can look like network loss.
units.misconception: 只校正流量計就能保證冷量計完全準確。~Calibrating flow alone guarantees accurate heat metering.
units.practice: 在「熱量計誤差與交接」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0666667 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「未配對校正探頭會把量測偏差當網路損失。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for heat-meter uncertainty and handover, first reproduce 0.0666667 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unmatched probe calibration can look like network loss." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
